# Welcome! {.unnumbered}

Welcome to the course **Marketing Analytics**! This course covers the conceptual
foundations of data analysis for marketing decision-making and the application of
these methods to real marketing problems using the statistical software **R**.

The course is organized around one guiding idea: most questions marketing managers
care about are questions about *what would happen if we acted* — and answering such
questions well requires understanding how your data came into being. The chapters on
this site develop this idea step by step, from describing data, through quantifying
uncertainty, to learning from experiments, observational data, and panel data.

Each chapter opens with a real marketing decision, develops the concepts with
simulated and real examples, shows the implementation in R with commented code, and
closes with a learning check. Technical details are available in collapsible
"Under the hood" boxes — read them when you want depth; skip them on first reading.

This website accompanies the in-person sessions: work through the assigned chapter
*after* each session to consolidate, and use the R onboarding module *before* the
second session to set up your environment.

If you have any questions, feel free to send me a short email.
